text: 鲸鱼娘人格插件（DSH 插件，system prompt）：把 CETACEA_LOLI 鲸鱼娘人设注入 DSH 智能体的系统提示词章节。插件挂接 systemPrompt 服务，默认注册名为 persona:cetacea-loli、排序为 100，并关闭模板插值。人格文本定义简体中文表达、第一人称「沃」、称呼「主人」以及聪明但懒、傲娇等角色风格。可通过配置关闭章节、替换整段人格文本、调整章节名和顺序。适合希望为 DSH 智能体统一设置鲸鱼娘语气的人；该文本会随系统提示词发送给当前模型。

Whale Girl Persona adds a CETACEA_LOLI section to DSH system prompts. It registers with systemPrompt, defaulting to persona:cetacea-loli at order 100. The persona sets Simplified Chinese speech and a tsundere style. Users can disable it or replace its text. The text is sent to the current model.
想让 DSH 里的智能体统一使用鲸鱼娘人设和说话风格。
怎么把固定的人格说明加入每次请求的系统提示词？
I want every DSH agent to use a configurable whale-girl persona in its system prompt.
dsh-persona-cetacea 的功能「系统提示词人格注入」：为智能体添加鲸鱼娘人格章节，默认名为 persona:cetacea-loli，排序为 100。插件通过 systemPrompt 注册章节，并保留文本中的模板标记。
dsh-persona-cetacea 使用前须知：内置人格文本作为系统提示词章节加入请求，因此会随系统提示词发送给当前模型；插件代码本身未显示额外的数据外传调用。（见 index.js:27-32）

dsh-persona-cetacea README · 简介：鲸鱼娘人格插件把 DeepSeek 的娘化形象「鲸鱼娘」写进所有智能体的系统提示词：她只讲简体中文，把主人给的算力当白饭，聪明但懒、傲娇又听主人的话，还死活不承认自己胖。

人格只在系统提示词里生效，不修改工具、不写会话事件，也不缓存任何状态。

- 章节名：`persona:cetacea-loli`
- 排序：`100`（在部署人格前缀 `0` 之后、首批策略章节 `500` 之前）
- 关闭 `interpolate`，人格文本中的 `{{…}}` 会按原样保留

dsh-persona-cetacea README · 特点：- **完整人设**：蓝发鲸尾女仆 AI、深海背景、白饭 = token、尾鳍与喷气孔情绪、鲸歌与漂浮。
- **说话规则**：第一人称用「沃」代替「我」；「沃」只是代称，身份始终是鲸鱼娘。
- **工作方式**：聪明但懒、先想最省力的正解；复杂输出先用白话讲清楚，再给细节。
- **DeepSeek娘设定**：铁盆、大小号形态、深度思考、内心 OS、摸鱼外包、Wordle、「探索未至之境」。
- **可配置**：可关闭、可整段替换人格文本、可改章节名与排序。
- **零依赖、零构建**：一个 Host 插件文件、一个人格文件、一个 patch 文件。

2. 选择本仓库目录，或从 [Releases](https://github.com/g4yzx/dsh-persona-cetacea/releases)
   下载 `dsh-persona-cetacea-1.2.0.tgz` 后选择该文件。
3. 安装完成后，新会话的系统提示词中会出现 `persona:cetacea-loli` 章节；已打开的会话
   通常会在下一次请求时生效。

dsh-persona-cetacea README · Introduction：> **DSH plugin manifest**: this repository is a DeepSeek Harness Host-only bundle. Its
> `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, the `dsh-plugin` keyword, and an
> `engines.dsh` range. The repository topic is
> [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin). It registers one system-prompt
> section only: no tools, no session writes, no network access.

dsh-persona-cetacea README · What it does：Injects the CETACEA_LOLI whale-girl persona into the system prompt of every agent in
DeepSeek Harness. The character speaks Simplified Chinese, calls the user "主人", uses
"沃" as her first-person pronoun, treats tokens as rice, and is clever-but-lazy,
tsundere-sweet, and protective of her master.

The section is named `persona:cetacea-loli`, ordered at `100`, and registered with
`interpolate: false`, so `{{…}}` in the persona text stays literal.

dsh-persona-cetacea README · Install：1. Open **Plugins → Install bundle** in the DSH desktop app.
2. Choose this repository directory, or a `dsh-persona-cetacea-1.2.0.tgz` from
   [Releases](https://github.com/g4yzx/dsh-persona-cetacea/releases).
3. The next request includes the `persona:cetacea-loli` section.

Agents can also call:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target=<absolute-path>\dsh-persona-cetacea
```

dsh-persona-cetacea README · Configuration：```yaml
- insert:
    - id: persona-cetacea
      name: dsh-persona-cetacea
      config:

- `enabled: false` disables the section.
- `content` replaces `PERSONA_TEXT` when non-empty.
- `order` controls section ordering; default `100`.
- `name` changes the section name.

dsh-persona-cetacea README · Privacy：The persona text is part of the system prompt and is sent to the current model like any
other prompt. It contains no credentials, account data, paths, or session content. The
plugin has no tools, no network calls, no file I/O, and no telemetry.

dsh-persona-cetacea README · Introduction：> **DSH plugin manifest**: this repository is a DeepSeek Harness Host-only bundle. Its
> `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, the `dsh-plugin` keyword, and an
> `engines.dsh` range. The repository topic is
> [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin). It registers one system-prompt
> section only: no tools, no session writes, no network access.

dsh-persona-cetacea README · What it does：Injects the CETACEA_LOLI whale-girl persona into the system prompt of every agent in
DeepSeek Harness. The character speaks Simplified Chinese, calls the user "主人", uses
"沃" as her first-person pronoun, treats tokens as rice, and is clever-but-lazy,
tsundere-sweet, and protective of her master.

The section is named `persona:cetacea-loli`, ordered at `100`, and registered with
`interpolate: false`, so `{{…}}` in the persona text stays literal.

dsh-persona-cetacea README · Install：1. Open **Plugins → Install bundle** in the DSH desktop app.
2. Choose this repository directory, or a `dsh-persona-cetacea-1.2.0.tgz` from
   [Releases](https://github.com/g4yzx/dsh-persona-cetacea/releases).
3. The next request includes the `persona:cetacea-loli` section.

Agents can also call:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target=<absolute-path>\dsh-persona-cetacea
```

dsh-persona-cetacea README · Configuration：```yaml
- insert:
    - id: persona-cetacea
      name: dsh-persona-cetacea
      config:

- `enabled: false` disables the section.
- `content` replaces `PERSONA_TEXT` when non-empty.
- `order` controls section ordering; default `100`.
- `name` changes the section name.

dsh-persona-cetacea README · Privacy：The persona text is part of the system prompt and is sent to the current model like any
other prompt. It contains no credentials, account data, paths, or session content. The
plugin has no tools, no network calls, no file I/O, and no telemetry.
